page.overview:
Who is Vlad Tepes?

Vlad Tepes was an apostle and the main villain of Berserk: The Prototype, a short story released in 1988.

Described as "a madman" and "insane", he displayed disdain for humans, seeing them as weak. Even when confronting Guts and being ultimately killed by him, Tepes dismisses the warrior as "only human". His acts as a fief lord depict him as a cold and ruthless man who spares no one, including women from his lands.

Ten years prior, this fief lord warred against a neighbouring country. He took five hundred prisoners and impaled every last one of them on wooden stakes, lining them up across the border. The fiefdom inhabitants were commanded not to remove the corpses. After the war, he turned on his own subjects. A rumor spread that the lord gathered young women from within the domain under the pretext of keeping them as maidservants, subsequently killing them every night. The rumor gained credibility when the body of one of the women from a certain village within the fiefdom was found stabbed through the neck in a river. Three more women hailing from that village were killed.

When Guts arrived at the fiefdom, Frikka's family urged him to kill the lord. Once the girl was taken to his castle, he greeted her, and asked Frikka to come closer. She noticed that she was walking alone and became aware that the lord, with his cold hands and rotten smell, is not human. Suddenly, an arrow pierced his left eye, having been shot by Guts. Vlad asked him who he is, to which he was answered by more arrows coming at him. From all sides, a rain of spears fell on Guts. Faced with the lord's mockery, Guts pulled one of the spears from his body and wielded the Dragon Slayer, shouting that he would mince Vana's dog. Tepes, having assumed his apostle form, wondered how he knew the name of the ancient lord of darkness, the most powerful god of their world and lord of those who are not human. After being grabbed by the apostle, Guts counterattacked, killing him after attacking with his mechanical arm and decapitating him with the Dragon Slayer. As he expressed disbelief on how a human beat an apostle of Vuana, Guts retorted with "Who else but a human would hate you bastards this much?". Before dying, the fief lord observed the Brand of Sacrifice to Vuana on the man's chest.
